_note: Curated bounty/certification criteria. The spec's area 6 draws on challenge criteria + project plan, which are NOT among the five generated source docs. To avoid a hand-curated record that can drift, each criterion references ONLY invariant IDs; the evidence itself is sourced live from invariants.json / traceability.json. Certification targets are NOT constitutional laws and must never weaken a true invariant.

criteria.title: Sync to tip from verified anchor
criteria.description: Import a verified Mithril snapshot or replay from genesis, then follow forward to the current tip with byte-identical, replay-equivalent state.

criteria.title: Block production
criteria.description: Forge a valid block: leader check, KES-signed real header, single canonical envelope, self-accept before serve.

criteria.title: N2N / N2C protocol coverage
criteria.description: Closed mini-protocol grammar with byte-identical round-trip across the N2N and N2C taxonomies.

criteria.title: Private testnet readiness
criteria.description: Operator-pass evidence on a private testnet, with a closed evidence manifest schema.

criteria.title: Tx validity agreement
criteria.description: Per-transaction validity verdicts agree with the reference node across the Conway corpus.

criteria.title: Block validity agreement
criteria.description: Block-level validity verdicts agree with the reference node.

criteria.title: Consensus tip agreement
criteria.description: Fork-choice selects the same tip as the reference node under the same inputs.

criteria.title: Power-loss recovery
criteria.description: Restart after a crash produces byte-identical state to a clean run (replay-equivalent recovery).

criteria.title: Memory measurement
criteria.description: Bounded, measured memory footprint on the authoritative paths.
